name: Y maze
description: Free exploration of a maze with three identical arms. Measures spatial working memory: animals with intact memory tend to visit the three arms in turn, and in a two-trial protocol prefer the newly opened arm.

parameters.label: Arm length
parameters.help: Length of one arm from the center of the maze to the arm tip. It is only used to check the drawn zones, not in the calculations.

parameters.label: Tracking gap tolerance
parameters.help: If the animal is lost for longer than this, the movement across the gap is not counted. Raise it only for low frame rate videos.

parameters.label: Novel arm
parameters.help: The arm that was closed in the first trial of a two-trial protocol: 0 for none, 1 for arm A, 2 for arm B, 3 for arm C.

events.label: Arm A visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in arm_a.

events.label: Arm B visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in arm_b.

events.label: Arm C visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in arm_c.

events.label: Arm A entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering arm_a.

events.label: Arm B entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering arm_b.

events.label: Arm C entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering arm_c.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.description: Time during which the animal could be tracked.
metrics.definition: Samples and calibrated zone shapes use the same coordinates in centimeters; zones are evaluated independently and include their boundary. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Distance traveled
metrics.description: Total length of the path the animal walked.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Total arm entries
metrics.description: How many arms the animal entered, including the arm it started in; a measure of general activity.
metrics.definition: The arm holding the first tracked sample counts as the first entry; each later arm entry follows the entry rule, and re-entering the same arm counts again. An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Spontaneous alternation
metrics.description: Share of three consecutive arm entries that visit three different arms; a lower value suggests impaired working memory.
metrics.definition: Share of overlapping entry triplets that visit three different arms.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (INSUFFICIENT_ENTRIES) with fewer than 3 entries; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Share of time in novel arm
metrics.description: Part of the analyzed duration spent in the novel arm; a higher share suggests the animal remembers the familiar arms.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration whose earlier sample is in the novel arm.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_APPLICABLE) when novel_arm is 0; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.
